zaira.routing.purpose: list category slugs and tool counts

description:
List all categories (topics) with the number of entries in each. A topic holds every kind of entry that does its job: tools and services, libraries, programming languages (the "language" category).

Returns: one line per category, sorted alphabetically. A topic of tools only reads "category_slug: N tools"; a topic that also holds libraries or languages counts each kind, "category_slug: 3 tools, 2 libraries". Filter zaira_search_tools by category and kind to see one kind within a topic.

Example call: no parameters.

Edge cases:
- Categories with zero tools do not appear in the output.
- Category slugs are lowercase-alphanumeric with hyphens (e.g., "relational-database", "vector-database", "frontend-framework", "mcp-server"). They may differ from casual category names — the slug form is canonical.

Risk: read-only, closed-world, idempotent — no state change possible.
name: zaira_list_categories
